name: Fleet Broadband
summary: Perth wholesale Internet infrastructure provider; acquired Paradox Digital c.2001; Eftel (Datafast) was a major investor; became DFT Wholesale.

events.details: Perth wholesale provider; existed by 2001 when it acquired Paradox Digital (Gemini ABN date of 2004 contradicted its 2002 Datafast deal).
Became a partly-owned subsidiary of Datafast; rebranded DFT Wholesale Internet.
